user.title: Connect Samsung Frame TV
user.description: Enter the address of your Frame TV. The TV shows a prompt asking to allow the connection – confirm it with the remote within 30 seconds.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the TV.
data_description.port: 8002 (secure websocket) works for all Frame models since 2018.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV, or the connection prompt was declined. Make sure the TV is on and try again.
error.not_frame: This TV does not support Art Mode.

data_description.sources: Shown in the media browser under RemArt. Sources that need an API key are skipped until a key is entered.
data_description.matte: Passe-partout for uploaded images, e.g. none, modern_apricot or shadowbox_polar.
data_description.prompt_prefix: Put in front of every description sent to the image model.

generate_and_show.name: Generate and show
generate_and_show.description: Generates an image with AI Task from a description and shows it on the Frame.

ai_task_entity.name: AI Task entity
ai_task_entity.description: Entity that generates the image. Defaults to the preferred image entity in the AI Task settings.
